# Pellumbra CLI releases

Pellumbra publishes one build per release. A plain install takes the newest
release on the stable channel; candidates stay opt-in and are never offered to
plain installs.

| release | channel | build | published |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 6.2-rc3 | candidate | 2444 | 2026-07-30 |
| 6.1 | stable | 2410 | 2026-05-19 |
| 5.9 | stable | 2218 | 2025-11-08 |

Build 2444 carries the new archive reader but is still a release candidate.
Build 2218 is the previous stable release and is kept for rollback; installs
that never moved to 6.1 still report it.

turns.prompt: Pellumbra CLI installs look after themselves on our build agents. Which build number does a plain install of Pellumbra CLI pick up? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
